rows.label: Net Change in Cash
rows.derivedFormula: Net Change in Cash = Operating + Investing + Financing Cash Flow

note: Printed in thousands of the reporting currency in the audited annual report and stored here in absolute units. Cash flow identity checked: Operating plus Investing plus Financing equals the printed net change in cash and cash equivalents. Capital expenditure is stored negative as the statement prints it, so free cash flow is Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure.
